items.title: Toddler Doodles
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
The kids aren't just doodling on walls - they've started drawing all over skins now! Pick your favorite doodle and wear it with pride!

- Hand-doodled HD skins
- Inspired by toddler doodles
- By 57Digital

items.title: Skateboarders
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Ready to shred? Then grab your board and hit the skatepark in one of these totally gnarly skins!

- 6 rad HD skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Demons
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Demons are here, and you can now become one of the 8 scary demons. Show us your horns and feel free to roleplay with your friends!

- 8 demons skins
- 1 free skin
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Levelatics

items.title: Free Spirits
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Now is a great time to release all the stress with the Free Spirits skin pack! The Free Spirits are a colorful and cheerful group of teens that enjoy their free living personality. 

Live a little with the Free Spirits!

- Free Spirits skin pack
- Colorful
- Cute
- Teen outfit skins

Free Spirits by: Pickaxe Studios and Matif

items.title: Stoneblock
items.creator: FTB
items.description:
Squidgyfaceplays and DanRobzProbz team up with Feed The Beast to bring you a feature filled underground survival adventure like never before! You spawn in a pocket of air surrounded by stone, and you must progress to survive!

- Over 30 unique quests!
- Lots of custom machines and equipment
- New blocks
- New tools and items
- Eight zones to discover

items.title: Trendy & Rich Teens
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Everyone is turning their heads around and taking pictures of these awesome trendy rich teens, flex on those haters by wearing the latest and trendy designer brands!

- 6 unique trendy teens!
- Perfect to become famous!
- By Pixelusion and Retro Block Studios

items.title: Ultra Skyblock Gamers
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Are you a cool gamer? Are you the best at skyblock? So prove it with this new ultra skyblock gamers pack, and beat the speedrun time record! Will you succeed?

- 80 ultra skyblock gamers skins
+ 2 free skins!
- By Pixelusion & SucreGappySan

items.title: ULTRA NEON 32 Extreme Parkour
items.creator: Piki Studios
items.description:
You wake in a quiet room, not really sure how you got here.. Welcome to the ULTRA NEON 32 - Extreme Parkour program.

- Perfect speed running map
- 32 challenging levels of difficulty
- 528 unique, ever changing parkour runs
- Timer to keep track of progress

-12 unique soundtracks to keep you sane
- Boosts including sprint, jump, and resurrect
- 6 super neon parkour skins

items.title: Volcano Island
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description:
After losing contact with the new Banin settlement, word has spread the town is deserted, will you investigate the town and the gigantic volcano?

- Custom world to explore
- Several custom textures

items.title: Mob Minis
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description:
Choose between various Mini Heads or even mobs like mini Witchi or Endermini! Carry them around and make sure to not lose your head!

- 10 skins included!

items.title: Evil Villagers
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Villagers can be evil too! Get to see what really goes on behind these doors with the Evil Villagers skin pack!

- 8 Evil Villager Skins
- By Rareloot

items.title: Anime Samurais
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Anime and samurais join together in the ultimate Japanese mashup skinpack. Grab your katana and join these heroic warriors of ancient Japan!

- 8 skins
- By Rareloot

items.title: Future Survival
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
The year is 2077: As a budding research scientist you have been offered a one in a lifetime research opportunity at the most prestigious laboratory facility in the country. 
Humanity’s survival depends on you. Will you take up the offer?

- Stunning survival spawn
- By RareLoot

items.title: Lava Hive Valley
items.creator: Team Phoenix Studio
items.description: Love living on the edge? Lava Hive valley is the place for you. Find your way up a tree, hang from a branch and live in harmony. Can you survive the heat?

items.title: Blackstone Castle
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Start exploring the world and conquer the various dungeons.
With numerous loot boxes, a great reward is waiting for you everywhere, which will help you to expand the world.

-Different dungeons
-Hides with loot
-Everything is accessible
-Adventure 
-Opportunity to expand the world

items.title: Cops and Criminals
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Will you represent the law or oppose it? Show your friends which side you've chosen with this cops and robbers skins!

+Comes with 1 free skin!
+By FallStudios

items.title: Mega Sky Grid
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Are you ready for a new skyblock experience? Build your way from cube to cube, find the Eyes of Ender in the chests scattered all over the grid, equip yourself and prepare for the battle with the Ender Dragon!

+Grid with thousands of cubes
+Single and multiplayer friendly
+By FallStudios

items.title: Vaporwave
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Chase the sunset with this Vaporwave skin set! 80s cyberpunk themed scenic designs to illuminate your world!

- 8 neon vapor skins!
- Awesome patterns with lofi vibes!
- Cool color gradients and stylish geometries!

items.title: Gradient Geos
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
From bright colors to sharp and sleek geometric patterns, this abstract pack has it all!

- 8 unique gradient skins!
- Awesome geometric patterns!
- Smooth gradients and stylish geometries!

items.title: Sisters World Tour 2021
items.creator: CanadaWebDeveloper
items.description:
Sisters World Tour – 2021 Lets you go to a concert with 4 main performers, dancers and security skins. Start your group's first performance together, NOW!


13 HD (128px) skins including:

- 1 free!
- 4 performers
- 3 boy dancers
- 3 girl dancers
- 2 security guards

1 Exclusive skin by: Dannny0117

Created and Published by: Dannny0117 + Canada Web Developer.

items.title: Potion Party
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
A rowdy group of adventures has been fighting mobs & has just returned from their quest! So grab your splash potions and take a seat with your friends, as they laugh and sing about their grand tale of danger and adventure!

- 12 skins!
- By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Planet Teens Skin Pack
items.creator: Ninja Squirrel Gaming
items.description:
These trendy, cosmic teen skins perfectly capture the solar system in their modern attire. Rock your zodiac sign and show off your astrological side to your friends! Planet Teens Skin Pack has 10 modern and cute skins to choose from. Represent your favorite in style!

- Includes galactic pastel skins, demon horns and zodiac colors.
- By Ninja Squirrel Gaming

items.title: Hoodie Kids
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
Hoodies are well-loved by people all over the world, so why not wear one in Minecraft? These adorable skins are perfect to wear during any season or any occasion! Express yourself and show off your style to your friends!

+ 14 custom skins for you to choose from!
+ Stylish for all ages
+ Collect all hoodie skin packs!

items.title: Wild West
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
The prairie is waiting for you! Learn something about the wild west, explore the town and surrounding farms, rob the bank or ride a horse through the countryside. 

- Perfect western town for roleplay
- By Artem Minenkov (artemin01) & FALL Studios
